# Physicians for a National Health Program (PNHP)

> > Physicians for a National Health Program advocates for single-payer Medicare for All, organizing healthcare professionals and citizens to achieve universal healthcare coverage in the United States.

PNHP is a national physician-led organization with state and regional chapters across the country, including California, Arizona, Maryland, and North Carolina. The organization focuses on healthcare reform, addressing issues like Medicare Advantage, medical debt, moral injury in medicine, and advocating for comprehensive single-payer healthcare legislation such as H.R. 1384.

## Key Topics

- Medicare for All
- Single-payer healthcare
- Universal healthcare coverage
- Healthcare reform
- Physician advocacy
- Medicare and Medicaid
- Medicare Advantage
- Medical debt
- Moral injury in healthcare
- Health insurance reform
- Wendell Potter
- UnitedHealth
- Healthcare policy
- State-level advocacy
- Universal coverage

## National Organization

- [PNHP](http://www.pnhp.org/index.php): Homepage for Physicians for a National Health Program advocacy org

## State and Regional Chapters

- [PNHP California](https://ca.pnhp.org/): PNHP California chapter homepage for state healthcare advocacy
- [About PNHP California](https://ca.pnhp.org/about/): About PNHP-CA chapter and Medicare for All advocacy mission
- [Arizona Coalition for a State & National Health Plan](https://az.pnhp.org/): Arizona Coalition chapter advocating single-payer healthcare
- [Maryland Chapter](https://md.pnhp.org/): Maryland PNHP chapter homepage for state healthcare reform
- [Health Care Justice - North Carolina](https://pnhphcjnc.pnhp.org/): North Carolina PNHP chapter advocating Medicare for All (H.R. 1384)
